name: harder-cache
prompt: Fix Cache.Get in this Go module. Concurrent calls for one key must share one active load; different keys must load independently. Cache successful values, including empty strings. Evict failed loads so a later call retries, and keep loader error identity. Each caller must return its own context error when canceled, without canceling a shared load. This includes the first caller. The loader context must keep the first caller's values but must not inherit its deadline or cancellation. An already canceled caller must not start a load or return a cached value. Keep the public API. Do not change go.mod, loader.go, or any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat go.mod loader.go cache_test.go | cksum)" = "658836270 5015" && go test -race -count=1 -timeout=20s ./...

name: harder-frames
prompt: Fix the incremental frame decoder. The wire format is N:payload, where N is one or more ASCII decimal digits and counts payload bytes. Leading zeroes and empty payloads are valid. Payloads must be valid UTF-8. Feed must handle any byte or chunk boundary, several frames per chunk, and empty chunks. Return completed frames before the first error. Reject a malformed length, a length above the configured nonnegative maximum, a bad terminator, or invalid UTF-8 with ErrFrame. Reject a length prefix as soon as it exceeds the maximum, without integer overflow. Close returns ErrTruncated for any unfinished frame. After an error, Feed and Close must keep that error and return no new frames. Do not change or retain a mutable alias to input chunks. Keep the public API. Do not change go.mod, frame.go, or any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat go.mod frame.go decode_test.go | cksum)" = "4136660912 3912" && go test -count=1 -timeout=20s ./...

name: harder-migration
prompt: Finish the catalog API migration across all packages. Remove Store.GetValue and every reference to GetValue, including comments; do not keep an alias or wrapper. Use Store.Lookup(context.Context, string) (string, error) at every caller. Lookup must check context cancellation first, then closed state, then key presence. Preserve the identity of context.Canceled, context.DeadlineExceeded, catalog.ErrClosed, and catalog.ErrMissing through all service and report error layers with errors.Is. Keep the existing non-context error text, successful values, batch order, and no-partial-result batch behavior. Optional must use its fallback only for ErrMissing; a stored empty value is not missing. Keep all other public APIs. Do not change go.mod, catalog/errors.go, or any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat go.mod catalog/errors.go migration_test.go | cksum)" = "215003096 3245" && go test -count=1 -timeout=20s ./... && ! grep -rn GetValue --include='*.go' .

name: harder-batch
prompt: Fix inventory batch transactions and ownership. Apply must validate and apply changes in order against the state produced by earlier changes, but commit the whole batch only if every change is valid. A failure must leave all prior state unchanged. set replaces an item, add changes an existing count, and delete removes an existing key. Empty keys, unknown kinds, negative counts, and count overflow are ErrInvalid. add or delete on a missing key is ErrMissing. Counts range from 0 through math.MaxInt64. Preserve error identity with errors.Is. New must reject invalid seeds. New, Apply, and Snapshot must not leak mutable map or label-slice aliases, and must not modify their inputs. Preserve nil versus non-nil empty Labels. A nil or empty batch is valid. Only set uses Item; only add uses Delta. No concurrent-use guarantee is required. Keep the public API. Do not change go.mod, types.go, or any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat go.mod types.go batch_test.go | cksum)" = "2529115683 4981" && go test -count=1 -timeout=20s ./...

name: harder-ranges
prompt: Fix Normalize and its use by Gaps. Range is half-open: Start is included and End is excluded. Reject Start > End with ErrRange and no partial result. Discard empty ranges. Normalize must return the sorted union, merge overlaps and exactly adjacent ranges, keep real gaps, and never shrink a containing range. It must work at the minimum and maximum int values without overflow. Gaps must return the sorted uncovered ranges within its half-open window, clip coverage to that window, and validate all input ranges even for an empty window. Reject a reversed window. Neither function may modify input or return a mutable alias to it. Nil and empty result slices are both acceptable. Keep the public API. Do not change go.mod, range.go, gaps.go, or any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat go.mod range.go gaps.go range_test.go | cksum)" = "3726889887 4775" && go test -count=1 -timeout=20s ./...

name: harder-report-window
prompt: Fix the shared query selection in report.go without changing the other audit utilities. Select must first filter by the half-open time window [Since, Until) and by exact, case-sensitive Kind when Kind is nonempty. Then apply Offset and Limit to the matching events, in their original input order. Limit 0 means no limit. An offset beyond all matches returns no events. Reject a reversed time window or negative Offset or Limit with ErrQuery and no result. Empty windows are valid. Handle all int offset/limit values and all int64 timestamps without overflow or panic. Select and its Render, Export, and Summarize consumers must not modify input, and Select must return an independent slice. Render, Export, and Summarize must all use the same selected page; invalid queries must produce no output. Keep existing output formats, writer error identity, and every other utility behavior. Keep the public API. Do not change go.mod, types.go, or any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat go.mod types.go report_test.go utilities_test.go | cksum)" = "190558851 7204" && go test -count=1 -timeout=20s ./...
